title: Hatsune Miku — Wrapped Up In Your Emotions〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage Wing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Free Cluster should be going on soon!
I can't wait to see them play! They're gonna be so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and to think that we get to see them from this close...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to commit everything Ms. Naruse and her band do to memory.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Can you all see everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, we can see just fine.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks for letting us watch with you!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No need for thanks. We want to show you all, too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, I think they're starting.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Free Cluster is about to perform.
This is the band Ichika and the others have been chasing after so desperately...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see them play.)

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wow...
So this is what Free Cluster sounds like live...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Video recordings don't do them justice at all. I mean, they electrified the air just by taking the stage...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They even changed how this song is structured from the beginning to the first chorus! I really like this arrangement.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too. And they immediately got the crowd's attention like we expected...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Everybody in the arena is going wild...
And this is just the first song.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, and it's a very good one. I can feel it resonating in my heart already...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<But it's not just her impeccable singing.
The bassist and drummer are also doing an excellent job of fanning the flame they've created.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They're able to spice things up without ruining the entire dish. This would excite any music lover worth their salt.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (In order to put on this kind of performance, you need both true passion for music, and the technical skill to back it up...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (In addition...)

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: You all came here today to release a lot of different feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Happiness, pain, sadness...
We're ready to take whatever you're carrying, so don't hold back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Her words have a way of moving your heart.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Ichika and the others were right.
They know how to guide their audience's emotions, and that's the result of a lot of work and planning.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can see why Ichika and the others chose to chase after them. I mean, what an unbelievable performance...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow... They transitioned so seamlessly into their next song...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I couldn't even tell that they'd started playing a new song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They used the guitar solo in the outro to maintain your attention, while gradually raising the key to start the next song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The drummer also started playing the intro with two beats left to go. They didn't just shrink the pause between the two songs, they actually overlapped them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, do you think we could do that with a couple of our songs?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I know how she feels...
She's also being influenced by this performance.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ichika and the girls are also trying to propel themselves forward.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And I need to do the same.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something just now, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, I was just saying...
This is an incredible show.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It is.
I can't take my eyes off of them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They're going to keep growing and growing.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They're going to write new songs, become better performers, play on bigger stages and share their music with the world.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (If I'm going to keep on being a senior they can look up to and rely upon...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I also have to keep doing what I can.)
